deviations_from_card: (1) Commit order: feat first, then test. Cases 1-7 fail until the feat lands, so the suite rides in a test commit after it, as the brief allows. Red-before (7 red, guard 8 green) was measured in the working tree before any source edit. (2) The Playwright capture ran against a COPY of desk/ in the scratchpad, with node_modules junctioned, not against the tree itself. The operator's dev server is on :3001 in this checkout, Next 16 refuses a second next dev in the same project, and next.config no longer reads DESK_NEXT_DIST_DIR. The copy was the working tree at that moment, with my changes. The copy and its data dirs were deleted afterwards. The recap-used capture was taken before a one-line change: the caption tag went from 'Used again' to the default 'Your mission', because the tag read oddly over the focused action's help. The picture is unchanged by it. (3) TV layout: on the recap-not-used screen, the sentence card first sat under the action row. So when a sentence is present it stands where the title 'Take it somewhere new' would be, as a compact card. The stones, the counts data line and the caption stay. The fix is composition in LingaTV.tsx only; linga.css was not touched. (4) Case 5 goes beyond the card's first sentence. The talk screen, on the line right after the reusing reply, shows the phrase once, under the caption tag 'Used again'. This is the card's 'reaches a screen only after it is used'. It is the only non-recap place the phrase appears. (5) Case 3 also asserts that the review was set, so it is red before. Without that it would pass vacuously. (6) Withholding on the phone: My map's 'Things Linga taught you' list hides the item under review while the scene is live and unused. Before, that list would have shown it mid-scene. The phone recap marks 'Used again tonight' or 'A sentence to take with you'. The map marks a reused item 'Used again in <scene>: "<quote>"'. (7) No new turn action and no new phone control, so TURN_ACTIONS, ACCEPTS, CONVERSATION_ACTIONS and VIEW_ACTION_IDS are unchanged. The coach prompt does not carry bringBack, so a coach alternative cannot leak the phrase. store.ts is not edited: load() spreads the saved conversation, so review persists, and taught persists through cleanTaught.
notes: REVIEW API (desk/src/lib/english/review.ts, pure): REVIEW_OFFERS=2. dueTaught(taught, episodeId) takes items with no reusedAt, offered<2, and a turnId not prefixed by episodeId, oldest by at, else null. reviewOf(t) gives Review {id, kind, better, fromTitle}. bringBack(c, taught) gives {phrase, meaning (the taught why), task} while c.review is set and unused, else null. findPhrase(text, phrase) matches word for word over tokens [\p{L}\p{N}]+ with inner apostrophes, lower-cased, with the curly apostrophe folded, and returns the original excerpt. reuseOf(reply, c) returns null when c.supported, when review is already used, or when the phrase was already shown (partner turns, c.cue, moments' better, coaching.after). usedLine(reply, quote) caps the reply at 180 characters by taking the sentence that holds the quote. offer() and markReused() return the new taught arrays. TYPES: Taught gains optional offered, reusedAt, reusedIn (a conversation id, the same as sessions[].id) and reusedQuote. Conversation.review?: Review|null, where Review adds used? (the learner's words) and usedTurn? (the learner turn id). SERVER: start computes id=randomUUID() first, then sets review and, after a successful opening, saves offered+1. context(c, invite) adds bringBack; coach passes invite=false. Turn: reuseOf(reply, c) runs on the pre-await snapshot. A hit writes the record in the same saveEnglish as evidence and moments, and sets next.review.used and usedTurn. VIEW: Hero track gains an optional sentence. Hero comparison gains optional art (an ArtKey; LingaTV artFor uses h.art ?? 'coach') and data (drawn as a DataLine after the caption). viewText prints the sentence and the data. Recap with review.used: the comparison hero, title 'It came back'. Recap with review unused: the track hero with the sentence. The linga-rules-test fixture helpers TAUGHT_A/B/C, REVIEW, REUSED and taughtStart() are at the end of the suite. Not done: uat/driver (linga-text.cjs) was not touched. It prints viewText, so the LT driver sees the new lines without a change. The real-model tools/linga-ui-test.cjs was not run: it needs LINGA_TEST_ALLOW_WRITES and a live model.
